# Profile — by hand

Plain steps by what the page shows, for when no automated method works: follow them with ordinary clicks and typing, or give them to the user. Take every value from the user and never invent one. If a login page, CAPTCHA or two-factor prompt appears, the user has to deal with it.

1. Open the app's /settings/profile page.
2. **The form**
    - Display name: type it (text, up to 40 chars). Required.
    - Job title: type it (text, up to 60 chars).
    - About you: type it (text, up to 280 chars).
    - Theme: choose one (Light · Dark · System).
3. Check every value, then click "Save profile", and only when the user has asked to submit. It worked if the page shows "Profile saved".
